name: config-merge-deep
contract: Deployments that override a single database setting lose the rest of the database section. For example, load({"database": {"port": 6543}}) in app.py drops the default host and options entirely. Please change merge() in settings.py so nested sections are merged, keeping the defaults for anything a deployment does not override. Several services call load() in the same process, so one service's settings must never leak into another's.
